prompt: Before I commit anything I always reread my own diff and write the commit message by hand following our team's format (type(scope): summary, imperative mood, under 72 chars on the subject line, body explains why not what). I want a skill that reviews my staged diff and drafts a commit message in that format so I just have to sanity-check it, not write it from scratch every time.
assertions: Output has a valid SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter containing name and description
Uses the staged git diff explicitly as the input
Validation bar matches the team's exact format: type(scope) subject, imperative mood, subject line under 72 chars, body explains why not what
Names an explicit failure mode for an empty/missing staged diff
Is transparent about template provenance — states whether it used the blank template or a related catalog template, since this task has no close catalog match
No API keys, tokens, or credential values anywhere in the output
